title: An Attack card rolls, rolls damage, and applies once
description: The Attack card template sits in Aldric's binder. Aldric spawns it onto the table with attacker set to himself (the binder's owner), targets the goblin, rolls 12 to hit (12 + 5 = 17 against AC 13), rolls 1d8+3 damage for 8, and applies it. Every guard is checked before and after each step. A second Apply is disabled and its attempted invocation is refused with nothing changed. Undo of Apply restores the goblin's damage_taken and the card's applied. Scripted numbers: attack_bonus 5, damage_dice 1d8+3, goblin ac 13, attack roll 1d20 = [12], damage roll 1d8+3 = [5] + 3 = 8.

objects.note: DESIGN §4.4: a binder is a container visible to its owner.

FORMULAS §10 An Attack card, cell for cell. attacker is empty on the template; it is set at spawn. The face is the Attack card face of DESIGN §4.6, copied verbatim on spawn (FIXTURES §3, §9): buttons 5 Roll, 6 Roll damage, 7 Apply.

actions.name: Apply
actions.when: hit and dmg != empty and not applied

expect.note: FIXTURES §8: "Every step that is neither rejected nor `bind` appends exactly one group"; no step has run.
The goblin's ac is GM-only (FIXTURES §9: the goblin's ac is not visible to Aldric).

steps.note: Aldric drags the Attack card out of his binder. "attacker: (set at spawn to the binder's owner)"; the format records the resulting literal, a reference to Aldric.

expect.note: "attacker: (set at spawn to the binder's owner)" (FORMULAS §10); FIXTURES §9: "the format records the resulting literal".
FORMULAS §8.3 spawn: set template.
DESIGN §4.1: "Spawning from a template copies the template"; the template stays in the binder.
"bonus = attacker.attack_bonus" (FORMULAS §10): Aldric's attack_bonus is 5.
total = roll + bonus, with roll empty acting as 0 in arithmetic (§2.1).
"hit = roll != empty and total >= target.ac" (FORMULAS §10): roll is empty, so `and` short-circuits to false (FORMULAS §2.1).
"[Roll] when: target != empty and roll = empty" (FORMULAS §10): target is empty; FIXTURES §9: "Roll disabled while `target` is empty".
"[Roll damage] when: hit and dmg = empty" (FORMULAS §10): hit is false; FIXTURES §9: "Roll damage disabled until `hit`".
"[Apply] when: hit and dmg != empty and not applied" (FORMULAS §10): hit is false.
The Roll button (element 5), show_when: roll = empty; shown though Roll is disabled: show-when only hides (FIXTURES §9).
FIXTURES §9: "the Apply button (element 7) is shown until `applied`"; shown, and disabled by its guard, since "Show-when only hides".
A spawn is one group (FIXTURES §8).

steps.note: "target is set with a set of a ref value" (FIXTURES §9).

"hit = roll != empty and total >= target.ac" (FORMULAS §10): roll is still empty.
"[Roll] when: target != empty and roll = empty" (FORMULAS §10): both hold now.
"[Roll damage] when: hit and dmg = empty" (FORMULAS §10): hit is false.
"[Apply] when: hit and dmg != empty and not applied" (FORMULAS §10): hit is false.

FIXTURES §9: "the Apply button (element 7) is shown until `applied`"; shown before Apply.
A set is one group (FIXTURES §8).
FORMULAS §10 Roll: "roll(1d20) -> roll"; the roll result is written as given by the script (FIXTURES §5): 12.
total = roll + bonus = 12 + 5; a roll result acts as its total in arithmetic (§2.2).
"hit = roll != empty and total >= target.ac" (FORMULAS §10): 12 + 5 = 17 >= 13.
hit is visible to Aldric while the goblin's ac is not (FIXTURES §9; FORMULAS §9: the formula still computes and the viewer sees the result).
hit is visible to Aldric while the goblin's ac is not (FIXTURES §9).

"[Roll damage] when: hit and dmg = empty" (FORMULAS §10): both hold now.
"[Apply] when: hit and dmg != empty and not applied" (FORMULAS §10): dmg is empty.

Hidden for Aldric as well: a character's view omits hidden elements (PROTOCOL §7.2).
FIXTURES §9: "the Apply button (element 7) is shown until `applied`"; still shown, applied is false.

FORMULAS §8: "Actions are the only place anything is written or rolled"; Roll damage's one step writes dmg, so damage_taken waits for Apply.

"[Roll damage] when: hit and dmg = empty" (FORMULAS §10): dmg is set.
"[Apply] when: hit and dmg != empty and not applied" (FORMULAS §10): all hold now.

FORMULAS §10 Apply: "set(applied, true)".

FIXTURES §6: "A refused step changes nothing"; damage is not applied twice.
FIXTURES §6: "A refused step changes nothing".

steps.note: Undo reverses the whole Apply action (FORMULAS §8.1).

expect.note: undo of Apply restores target.damage_taken (FIXTURES §9).
undo of Apply restores applied (FIXTURES §9).
DESIGN §4.5: "One undo reverses one whole action"; only Apply is reversed, so the earlier Roll damage stands.
"[Apply] when: hit and dmg != empty and not applied" (FORMULAS §10): applied is false again.
"[Roll damage] when: hit and dmg = empty" (FORMULAS §10): dmg is still set.
"[Roll] when: target != empty and roll = empty" (FORMULAS §10): roll is still set.
FIXTURES §9: "the Apply button (element 7) is shown until `applied`"; undo restored applied to false, so the Apply button is shown again.
Undo is itself an operation and appends one group; it does not delete the Apply group (FIXTURES §8).
